T1.jsonl.what: base with cue, T 1.0 / top-p 1.0 (RLN-4 T1)

T2.jsonl.what: RL, plain prompt, T 1.0 / top-p 1.0 (RLN-4 T2)

halves.split: row j of a cell's rows (in order of problem index) is in half A when j is even, in half B when j is odd

attr.split: row j of a cell's rows (in order of problem index) is in half A when j is even, in half B when j is odd

bias.arm_2: bias_layer: the RL layer is called with the args and kwargs of the base's layer (no cache object with use_cache=False)
bias.rounding: bias_mlp, bias_layer, bias_mlp_rnd, bias_zero: stochastic to bf16; *_nearest: round to nearest

dense.rule: |a| above the layer's p97 of |a| at more than 0.5 of half A's scored positions
